page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg9i.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated Intel Xeon 6982P-C virtual processors operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This server type does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It also lacks dedicated graphics processing units. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated Intel Xeon processors, this instance is designed for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for application servers, web serving, containerized microservices, and moderate database hosting. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities for workloads that cannot tolerate the resource contention typical of shared-core environments.
